The body is a rounded rectangle of matte dark graphite plastic (#1C1B1A) framed by a thin machined aluminum bezel (#9A9EA4) with chamfered, lightly polished edges. The upper two-thirds of the front is the empty recessed cassette compartment: a dark matte interior, two white toothed reel spindles, and along the bottom edge of the compartment a chrome tape head, a black rubber pinch roller and a thin metal capstan. Two small hinge knuckles sit on the bottom edge of the compartment opening.
